title: An epimorphism of sheaves of sets is the coequalizer of its kernel pair
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ its category of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (for a topological space $X$, $\mathcal C$ may be the site $\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ of open subsets of $X$ with inclusions as morphisms and open covers as coverings, whose sheaves of sets are the sheaves of sets on $X$). Let $p:\mathcal P\to\mathcal F$ be an epimorphism of $\Sh(\mathcal C)$, and let $(K,r,s)$ be a fibre product of $p$ with itself in $\Sh(\mathcal C)$, i.e. $r,s:K\rightrightarrows\mathcal P$ with $p\circ r=p\circ s$ such that for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal T$ and morphisms $a,b:\mathcal T\to\mathcal P$ with $p\circ a=p\circ b$ there is exactly one $c:\mathcal T\to K$ with $r\circ c=a$, $s\circ c=b$ (such a fibre product exists and may be computed sectionwise, $K(U)=\mathcal P(U)\times_{\mathcal F(U)}\mathcal P(U)$, by [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaf-sets-limits-sectionwise]). Then $(\mathcal F,p)$ is a coequalizer of $r,s$ in $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]: for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ and every morphism $q:\mathcal P\to\mathcal G$ with $q\circ r=q\circ s$ there is exactly one morphism $u:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ with $u\circ p=q$.

source.place: Sites, Lemma Tag 086K (lemma-coequalizer-surjection), stated for a surjection of sheaves of sets, which is the same as an epimorphism of Sh(C) by Sites, Lemma Tag 00WN (lemma-mono-epi-sheaves)
